To craft a water_bucket, the agent needs iron ingots (provided in inventory) and must locate water — the quartz_block serves as a landmark near the water source where clay is also found. Mining clay confirms the agent reached the water area, and crafting the water_bucket requires being near a crafting table with iron ingots. Uses inventory_has because mining red sandstone with a pickaxe drops the red_sandstone block item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with a wooden pickaxe which is sufficient to mine red sandstone. One block mined = 1 red_sandstone in inventory.

Uses inventory_has with clay_ball because mining a clay block drops 4 clay_ball items (NOT the clay block itself, which requires Silk Touch). The player has a wooden shovel which is the correct tool for mining clay. Checking for min_count=4 confirms at least one full clay block was mined.

Uses inventory_has because the final water_bucket item ends up in the player's inventory after both steps are completed: (1) crafting an empty bucket from 3 iron ingots at the crafting table, and (2) right-clicking on a water source block to fill it. Checking for water_bucket confirms the entire two-step process was completed successfully.
